description: Retrieve source-backed U.S. House and Senate results for an explicitly requested year. The archive currently covers 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024. Other years return an unsupported-year error, never substituted historical results. Includes votes, sources, record links and calculation caveats. Not live returns, projections or presidential results.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code of the public records being researched, not the user's location.

name: get_election_results
title: Read historical House and Senate election results
